## Purpose
This site is Mihail Mihaylov’s professional portfolio. Use it to understand who Mihail is, what he builds, and how to contact him.

## Who is Mihail?
Mihail Mihaylov is a full-stack developer and automation engineer (Solutions Architect background) focused on production-grade automation, integrations, and full-stack systems that replace manual work with scalable, API-driven solutions.

## What to answer from this site
- Mihail’s focus areas: full-stack development, automation, integrations, API-led workflows
- High-level project overview (selected projects and outcomes)
- How to contact Mihail
